title: Rust gateway trust store opens state file without O_NOFOLLOW (spec 06-security 8.7 hardening MUST)
description:
Spec 06-security.md §8.7 (lines ~300-302): 'Trust and private-key stores MUST use owned private directories, non-following regular-file opens, interprocess locks, unique mode-0600 temporary files, atomic replacement, and file plus directory fsync.'

Requirement: R-06-048 (spec-coverage matrix docs/spec-coverage/06-security-part1.md).

Classification: divergent.
Evidence: rust/lichen-gateway/src/trust.rs:740 uses plain File::open(path) with no O_NOFOLLOW; OpenOptions at :842-846 (temp file) and :890 (reload) set no custom_flags. Everything else conforms: rename :851, file+dir fsync :849-859, unique 0600 temp create_new :842-846, rollback floor :778-783. Python (key_persistence.py:71,101,106-121) and rust/lichen-hal/src/storage.rs:489-496,622-649 implement O_NOFOLLOW/symlink-refusal fully. Compare rust/lichen-gateway/src/config.rs:245 which does use O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC.

Suggested placement: add libc::O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC custom_flags to the three open sites in rust/lichen-gateway/src/trust.rs (load :740, temp create :842-846, reload :890); mirror the hal storage.rs regular-file/inode check on load.
